scope: Internal certified finite-bit implementation gate; no external novelty or production certification
randomness_contract: Probability theorem assumes independent unbiased input bits via BitCallbackBank or another compatible bank. Initial SHA256 fixtures are deterministic evidence. One fresh os.urandom acquisition was recorded without reselection and replayed from preserved raw blocks; source independence remains an explicit assumption.
reference_metric: Exact rational enclosure of an ideal same-W Brown/Cox H, valid for every extension of the accepted finite uniform cells.
test_history_note: An intermediate test incorrectly required total failure below 0.01; it was corrected to the verified bound 59429/5242880 < delta/4. Audit-discovered float overflow and decimal serialization failures were fixed and now have passing regressions. No probability budget was weakened.
rational_encoding: Exact decimal fraction text normally; explicit hexadecimal numerator/denominator if either exceeds 10,000 bits. Display-only float is null on overflow.
